facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - electrical exposure at P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3220 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 26 November 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on P-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
